test_objective: Check that you can delete an attribute of a temporal representation of an entity with simple temporal properties

test_cases.name: 015_01_01 Delete an attribute from a temporal representation of an entity without deleteAll/datasetId
test_cases.doc: Check that you can delete an attribute of a temporal representation of an entity with simple temporal properties
test_cases.template: Delete Attribute From A Temporal Entity
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/temporal/entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attributeId}?${params_as_string}'
        method set to 'DELETE'
        Delete Attribute From Temporal Entity: and
    Query Parameter: entityId set to '${temporal_entity_representation_id}' and
    Query Parameter: attributeId set to 'fuelLevel' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/json' and
    Query Parameter: datasetId set to '${datasetid}' and
    Query Parameter: deleteAll set to '${deleteall}' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld'
}
